title: Monsters in Crisis
style: Photorealistic, shot on a broadcast cinema camera, 16:9. A real American daytime talk-show studio: warm key lighting, soft fill, glossy dark-blue set with a large backlit city-skyline panel, beige carpeted riser, studio audience in tiered seats in soft shadow. Natural film grain, shallow depth of field on close-ups, slow and steady camera moves only. Completely serious tone, as if this is a genuine televised family intervention. No comedy music, no laugh track, no cartoon effects, no exaggerated acting, no on-screen text.

characters.HOST: the host, a composed television psychologist in his sixties with short silver hair and a neatly trimmed grey beard, navy suit, open-collar white shirt, reading glasses folded in his hand; calm, direct, faintly disappointed
characters.KAIJU: a giant charcoal-grey reptilian kaiju with rough, pebbled scales, rows of jagged pale dorsal plates and a long tail curled beside the chair, scaled down just enough to sit in an oversized reinforced talk-show armchair; heavy, still, ashamed body language
characters.APE: an enormous silverback gorilla with dark brown fur greying across the shoulders, battle scars on the brow, sitting upright in a second oversized reinforced armchair with huge hands resting on his knees; proud, guarded, easily wounded

audio_bed: Quiet studio room tone: faint air-conditioning hum, one distant cough, the creak of a heavy chair. No music.

shots.name: establishing_wide
shots.camera: Wide locked-off shot from behind the audience, slow push-in.
shots.action: HOST sits in a normal armchair facing KAIJU and APE, who sit side by side in oversized armchairs a careful distance apart. Nobody speaks. KAIJU's tail shifts slightly. The audience is motionless.
shots.audio: Room tone only. A heavy chair creaks.

shots.name: host_boundaries
shots.camera: Medium close-up on HOST, eye level, slight over-the-shoulder of KAIJU's scaled shoulder in soft-focus foreground.
shots.action: HOST leans forward, elbows on knees, glasses in hand, and speaks evenly to KAIJU.

dialogue.speaker: HOST
dialogue.line: Godzilla, Kong says you don't respect his personal boundaries.
dialogue.delivery: calm, measured, low voice, neutral American accent, no smile

shots.audio: Dialogue clean and close-miked, quiet room tone underneath.

shots.name: kaiju_looks_down
shots.camera: Slow push-in to a close-up of KAIJU's face.
shots.action: KAIJU silently lowers his gaze to the carpet. His nostrils flare once. His eyes stay down. A long, uncomfortable pause.
shots.audio: Silence and room tone. A faint low exhale from the creature.

shots.name: host_look_at_me
shots.camera: Tight close-up on HOST, locked off.
shots.action: HOST tilts his head slightly and holds steady eye contact, unblinking.

dialogue.speaker: HOST
dialogue.line: I'm going to need you to look at me when I'm talking to you.

shots.name: ape_nods
shots.camera: Medium shot of APE, slight angle from HOST's side.
shots.action: APE glances sideways at KAIJU, then gives two slow, approving nods toward HOST, lips pressed together.
shots.audio: Room tone, the leather of the chair creaks as APE shifts.

shots.name: host_skyscraper
shots.camera: Medium close-up on HOST as he turns his head from KAIJU to APE, camera holds.
shots.action: HOST turns to APE and gestures once, open-palmed, with the folded glasses.

dialogue.speaker: HOST
dialogue.line: And Kong, throwing a skyscraper at somebody is not healthy communication.

shots.name: ape_offended
shots.camera: Close-up on APE's face, very slow push-in.
shots.action: APE's brow lowers, his lips purse, and he leans back slightly in the chair, visibly offended. He looks away toward the audience, then back. No roar, no chest beating.
shots.audio: A short, indignant huff through the nose. Room tone.

shots.name: host_seventeen_cities
shots.camera: Two-shot past both creatures toward HOST, then hold.
shots.action: HOST looks from one creature to the other and delivers the line without blinking.

dialogue.speaker: HOST
dialogue.line: You two have destroyed seventeen cities. At some point, we have to stop blaming the cities.
dialogue.delivery: slow, deliberate, a beat of silence between the two sentences

shots.name: silent_audience
shots.camera: Reverse wide on the studio audience from the stage, slow lateral drift.
shots.action: The audience sits completely silent and still. One woman slowly lowers her hand from her mouth. Nobody laughs or claps.
shots.audio: Dead silence except room tone and a single distant cough.

shots.name: final_hold
shots.camera: Wide shot of all three from the side of the stage, locked off.
shots.action: Nobody moves. After a long beat KAIJU slowly raises his eyes to meet HOST's. APE keeps staring straight ahead. Hold.
